liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **What The World Needs Now Is Love** (1 other source): Identified as a Burt Bacharach cover in the setlist [4]
- **Rebel Rebel** (1 other source): Identified as a David Bowie cover in the setlist [6]
- **Touch Me I'm Going to Scream part 3** (1 other source): Listed in the setlist notes provided by the uploader [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **August 2016 (Saturday)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [13]
- **What The World Needs Now Is Love**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [13]
- **Lay Low &gt**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [13]
- **Could You Be Loved**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [13]
- **Purple Rain**: rare: 4 archived performances [13]
- **Rebel Rebel**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [13]

## The recordings

- **mmj2016-08-27** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 136 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **mmj2016-08-27.stream.sbd**: soundboard; 18 songs; 136 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **mmj2016-08-27.CM-33**: audience recording; 18 songs; 135 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: Recording is described as great sounding despite being a cover-heavy set [8]
- **mmj2016-08-27.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 136 min [5]
- **mmj2016-08-27.MMJ.Lockn.8.28.16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 136 min [6]

## Around the show

- First performance after summer hiatus due to band members touring with Ray Lamontagne [8]
- Reviewer watched the live stream and loved the set list [10]
- Band dominated the Lockn' festival, impressing the hippie crowd [11]
- Recording position was front left corner of the soundboard [5]
- Microphones positioned 60 feet back from stage, dead center [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2016-08-27**: taped by Alex Leary; transferred by Alex Leary; source: DPA 4023 > Tascam DR-70D (24/48) [1]
- **mmj2016-08-27.stream.sbd**: transferred by Sanders DeNardi; source: SBD > Youtube [2]. Also: Ripped from short-lived YouTube stream, split and named by uploader [2]
- **mmj2016-08-27.CM-33**: taped by opsopcopolis; transferred by opsopcopolis; source: AUD [3]
- **mmj2016-08-27.flac16**: taped by Steve Baker; transferred by Zappafan2; source: Nakamichi CM700's>Marantz pmd661MKII [5]
- **mmj2016-08-27.MMJ.Lockn.8.28.16**: taped by pat myers, datpat; transferred by Pat Myers; source: Neumenn TLM 170R>Zoom F-8 [6]. Also: Recorded by Pat Myers using Blumlein XY figure eight microphones [6]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Ian Rawn Share: [My Morning Jacket Debuts A Pair Of Covers At Lockn’ Festival](https://www.jambase.com/article/morning-jacket-debuts-pair-covers-lockn-festival) [14]
